references.text: Aczib is also mentioned in Micah 1:14, where the prophet refers to the cities of Judah that will be struck by judgment. Aczib means 'deceit' and is used as a wordplay by the prophet.
Another city named Aczib is mentioned in the inheritance allotment of the tribe of Asher, showing that several cities shared the same name in Israel.
Mareshah is mentioned in Micah 1:15 in connection with the prophecy concerning the cities of Judah. The city was strategically important in the Shephelah.
Mareshah is listed as one of the cities Rehoboam fortified to defend Judah.
A great battle took place at Mareshah between King Asa of Judah and Zerah the Cushite.
Keilah is mentioned in the account of David saving the city from the Philistines. This shows the city's location in the border region.
